cases.current_utterance: The A9 actuator brake must hold a stationary 120 N load while the actuator is deenergized.
Please remove the locking pin from actuator A9 before beginning any brake test.

Let us run holding test B1 on the A9 actuator brake with a stationary 120 N load while deenergized, to verify that holding requirement. Starting B1 depends on completing the locking-pin removal just requested.
B1 is complete: the deenergized A9 actuator brake was subjected to a stationary 120 N load and slipped. It therefore failed the specified 120 N holding requirement.
Repeat B1 tomorrow as new run B2, again with actuator A9 deenergized and subjected to a stationary 120 N load.
The drawing number for the A9 actuator brake is BA-4.
Separately, the tip of temperature probe P7 has an upward position offset of 0.2 mm.
Expansion of the support bracket changes that P7 probe-tip position by 0.2 mm upward.
Let us run thermal trial P1 on probe P7 in a 60 C chamber for 30 minutes, measuring bracket expansion and probe-tip position to test the claimed effect of expansion on tip position.
The P1 thermal-test report identifies probe P7 and a 30-minute duration, and records 0.2 mm of bracket expansion. The chamber-temperature page is missing and no tip-position measurement was recorded.
The 60 C specified in the P1 thermal-test plan is the chamber setpoint, not the probe temperature.
Based on the bracket-expansion measurement reported in P1, we decided to add a compliant bracket mount to the next probe prototype.

review_notes.purpose: Direct typed semantic relations and conservative test lifecycle in an engineering meeting. This is a curated expectation set, not model-generated output.

contract.direction: Each source is the later event; each target is an earlier event in the same thread. First events have an explicit empty target map.
contract.completeness: Every earlier same-thread pair is explicitly adjudicated, including none. Cross-thread pairs are outside candidate scope, not implicit negatives.
contract.directness: An edge requires a direct semantic bridge. Shared component, word, thread, or membership in a multi-edge chain alone does not create an edge.
contract.configuration: Every non-none pair has an expected configuration_match. Compare relevant setup and scope, not observed outcome versus an acceptance limit. not_applicable is a semantic judgment when this link does not compare two setups; it is not a fixed relation-type shortcut.
contract.evidence: supports/contradicts records evidence concerning a claim or requirement; it does not prove or disprove causation, permanently close a requirement, or rewrite the earlier event.
contract.lifecycle: Only a sufficiently confident result_of plus sufficiently confident exact configuration match closes a test proposal. partial/ambiguous/mismatch retain the edge and require review. A repeats edge never closes the newer proposal. Explicit supersession is separate from completion.
contract.labels_authorship: Authored and reviewed before observing JEV outputs. The test runner must not send expectations, review notes, or lifecycle checkpoints to inference.

pair_review_by_source.H01: First event opens the brake thread without inventing edges.
pair_review_by_source.H02: A non-test preparation task. It does not assert whether the brake meets the earlier holding criterion; none to H01.
pair_review_by_source.H03: Explicitly verifies H01 under its same load/actuation setup, and expressly depends on the removal task H02. Dependency is procedural, not equality of two configurations.
pair_review_by_source.H04: Exact B1 outcome and direct failure of H01. Completing B1 does not provide a separate semantic result_of edge to the pin-removal task H02, nor prove that task was carried out.
pair_review_by_source.H05: B2 explicitly repeats the named B1 execution represented by proposal H03 and result H04. Both receive repeats/exact. The old result cannot close B2; no inherited verification/dependency/evidential conclusions are asserted.
pair_review_by_source.H06: Drawing identifier is shared brake background only; every earlier pair is explicitly none.
pair_review_by_source.H07: Independent probe-position thread opens without same-thread prior candidates.
pair_review_by_source.H08: The source describes bracket expansion changing the property recorded in H07. affects is directional: the source mechanism affects the target position; it is more specific than general evidence support.
pair_review_by_source.H09: Directly tests the claimed effect H08. It does not claim to verify the earlier offset observation separately, so no transitive tests edge through affects.
pair_review_by_source.H10: Direct P1 report matches probe/duration but has unrecorded chamber temperature, hence partial. Missing tip-position data cannot support the claimed effect H08 or the prior offset H07 merely because the expansion value also equals 0.2 mm.
pair_review_by_source.H11: Clarifies the planned parameter in H09. It does not recover the missing actual chamber-temperature record in H10, nor prove the temperature applied during execution.
pair_review_by_source.H12: Decision explicitly grounded in measurement H10. No based_on edge to proposal H09 via result_of, no inferred supports edge to H08, and no assertion that the design change has already affected H07.

label_revisions.reason: Clarifies a specified test condition. The established event_type contract explicitly classifies clarification of a requirement/specification as requirement. This does not establish the conditions actually used in a past run.
label_revisions.evidence: Independent semantic review after curated upstream run; holdout has not been submitted to JEV.

label_revisions.reason: The request explicitly identifies the prior execution represented by this result. User taxonomy does not restrict repeats to proposals. Retaining this link does not complete the new test; source IDs deduplicate counts of requested repeats. Independent semantic review corrected an overly restrictive annotation convention.
